g.text: Q_mix = (1 − G) ⊙ Q + G ⊙ Fw. The code uses the equivalent difference G ⊙ (Fw − Q).

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #657487

g.text: Q_out = Q + λ_gate × LN(Q_mix − Q). LayerNorm is inside the residual branch, not after the addition.

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #657487

g.text: Each decoder layer learns an independent λ_gate. If λ_gate = 0, Q_out equals Q exactly.
